changelog.summary: Brief 01: first curriculum audit, outcome decomposition, learning graph, schemas and validator.

Review corrections: typed answer contracts for every exercise family (with scale/chromatic derivations), notation for tuplets, beams, chords, voices, whole-bar rests and annotations, lesson-level exercise bindings with taught-scope enforcement, verification of every accepted alternative, tied accidentals, lesson/node version agreement, platform-independent paths and line endings.

Re-review corrections: presentation-aware notation (stave / rhythm-line / keyboard) so early rhythm and keyboard lessons need no untaught clef; interval checks honour the allowed minor forms (membership and numbered builds), with optional minorForm.
